# Contributing to Flex

The rules for contributing are on the documentation site, in
[Conventions](https://govuk-once.github.io/flex/start/conventions/): code, dependencies, pull
request titles, the pull request process, pre-commit hooks and documentation.

Pull request titles must follow `<JIRA-REF> <type>(<scope>)?: <description>`, such as
`FLEX-123 feat: add user preferences endpoint`. CI checks the format.
